context: area: public-access UX, credentials, endpoint lifecycle, player compatibility, and verification
constraint: Fallout Terminal Constitution v4.0.0 public-access and secret governance
constraint: completed feature artifacts remain unchanged
intent: Enable a game master to publish protected ngrok access from the packaged app while preserving local play and secret safety.
expectations: No project-owned relay service or support for providers other than ngrok.
No shared developer account or automatic ngrok account registration.
No replacement of Basic Auth with player OAuth.
No changes to local broadcast semantics, player roles, or authoritative game behavior.
No public app-store or marketplace release.
No simulated evidence for unavailable external release gates.

decisions.decision: Do not add application-level Basic Auth rate limiting or account lockout.
decisions.why: User selected provider-side throttling only during clarify.

decisions.decision: Pin golang.ngrok.com/ngrok/v2 at v2.1.4 and use one explicit Agent/Forward runtime.
decisions.why: It is the current stable official embedded SDK, forwards to the existing player server, and removes CLI/PATH ownership.
decisions.rejected: External ngrok CLI, DefaultAgent environment auth, older or floating SDK versions.

decisions.decision: Keep Basic Auth at the application HTTP boundary and do not add ngrok Traffic Policy auth.
decisions.why: Header-only application auth is directly testable and does not buffer the ConnectRPC streaming response; edge policy lacks independent non-buffering proof.
decisions.rejected: Edge-only auth or dual edge/application auth.

decisions.decision: Pin github.com/keybase/go-keychain at v0.0.1 behind a scoped SecretStore adapter with isolated dev/prod service names.
decisions.why: It calls native Security.framework without shell commands and supports exact presence/update/delete semantics behind deterministic fakes.
decisions.rejected: security CLI wrappers, plaintext/encrypted Application Support storage, shared dev/prod Keychain namespace.

decisions.decision: Persist a separate version-1 public-access.json with only non-secret preferences and reconcile Keychain presence at runtime.
decisions.why: This preserves session/player-config v1 and gives atomic private recovery without trusting stale presence hints.
decisions.rejected: Game-data fields, secret values in config, or presence hints as authority.

decisions.decision: Use a monotonic generation plus settings revision and a dynamic player policy with external default deny.
decisions.why: The current static exact-host check is fail-open for unknown Hosts and cannot reject stale start/reconfigure completion.
decisions.rejected: Static PublicAccess configuration or a boolean started flag.

decisions.decision: Load saved preferences at launch but require explicit UI Start on every run.
decisions.why: The approved packaged UX forbids implicit public exposure and stale endpoint restoration.
decisions.rejected: Auto-start from enabled preference or legacy env/args.

decisions.decision: Remove CLI/env/process configuration after embedded parity and retain only constructor/test-harness injection through the same SDK manager.
decisions.why: This preserves deterministic and opt-in automation without a second production mechanism.
decisions.rejected: NGROK_BIN, process runner fallback, or packaged environment/argument switches.

decisions.decision: Add a new private public_access.proto and leave frozen runtime.proto/server-info compatibility intact.
decisions.why: A separate typed snapshot/event carries lifecycle and presence without weakening the existing Wails v3 digest gate or exposing secrets.
decisions.rejected: Adding secret/status fields to public player contracts or overloading frozen RuntimeStatus.

decisions.decision: Host alone is insufficient to classify direct local/LAN ingress on the shared forwarded listener; authoritative pinned-provider behavior is required before implementation and a real Host-override probe runs when prerequisites exist.
decisions.why: Prevents a remote Host override from bypassing application-level Basic Auth through the local/LAN allowance.
decisions.rejected: Relying on deterministic fakes, untrusted forwarding headers, or moving Basic Auth to Traffic Policy without streaming proof.

decisions.decision: Full embedded-only package, security, reproducibility, leak, lifecycle, and rollback gates run before CLI source deletion and rerun after deletion.
decisions.why: Satisfies constitution cutover ordering and catches packaging regressions on both the rollback candidate and final tree.
decisions.rejected: Deleting the CLI after only package preflight and qualifying the package afterward.

decisions.decision: Root composition and internal/tunnel own temporary coexistence; it expires at same-feature T075 removal after an immutable pre-removal reference and clean rollback rebuild are recorded.
decisions.why: Makes bounded migration ownership, expiry, rollback evidence, and removal gate explicit.
decisions.rejected: A selectable dual-runtime production switch or reuse of completed feature artifacts as rollback proof.

decisions.decision: Stop at T037 without a dialer, Host-trust, alternate-source, privileged-interface, or second-server fallback
decisions.why: The approved source-bound security acceptance failed and the implementation guardrails require fail-closed behavior
decisions.rejected: Default SDK dialer, Host-only classification, privileged lo0 alias mutation, alternate source, and second player server

decisions.decision: Require Go 1.26.6 as the root module minimum
decisions.why: Official govulncheck found five reachable standard-library vulnerabilities in Go 1.26.5, all fixed by 1.26.6
decisions.rejected: Shipping the reproducible Go 1.26.5 candidate with applicable unresolved advisories

approach: Embed the exactly pinned official ngrok Go SDK behind a provider-neutral endpoint interface, with a generation-aware manager that activates an exact player Host policy before publishing any URL. Persist only non-secret preferences atomically, keep both secrets in macOS Keychain behind scoped-use interfaces, expose typed private protobuf/Wails operations, then delete the CLI runtime after parity.

plan.summary: Designed the pinned embedded SDK/Keychain cutover, generation-aware lifecycle, atomic Host/Auth policy, typed desktop contracts, secure settings UX, migration, and full verification matrix.
plan.key_finding: Current middleware treats every nonmatching valid Host as local, so fail-closed dynamic Host policy is a foundational security change, not merely an SDK runner swap.

tasks.summary: 83 test-first tasks across 9 dependency-ordered phases, with authoritative Host-ingress gating, full pre-removal package and rollback proof, CLI removal, and post-removal requalification.

specify.summary: Specified embedded ngrok public access for the existing player server with UI configuration, Keychain-only secrets, endpoint Basic Auth, local failure isolation, bounded cleanup, embedded-only packaging, and conditional real-provider evidence.
specify.key_finding: Public access is optional and must never weaken or interrupt the authoritative local/LAN player mode.
specify.risks: Cmd+Q, partial-start, forced-owner-loss, relaunch, cutover, and final qualification remain unverified.

implement.summary: Shipped embedded SDK public access with Keychain-only secrets, Basic Auth protected player access, CLI removal, Go 1.26.6 security requalification, reproducible macOS package, and explicit external NOT RUN evidence
implement.key_finding: Deterministic close ownership, race, leak, build, signature and package verification pass; packaged interactive normal-close evidence does not.
risks: Phase 9 cutover is forbidden until T067 passes
No real-ngrok opt-in evidence was run
